title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(津田敏宏研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Tsuda Toshihiro)
educationalGoal: The subject of this course is a basic study on rotating machines, which is useful for solving environmental and energy issues. Through the study, students will: (1) learn how to find technical challenges and solve them. (2) learn how to compile technical reports and give their presentations.
advice: In this course, we will cover the following topics: 1. Design and analysis of rotating machines. 2. Development of a new type of rotating machine. Students are required to actively participate in class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clearly define the goal of the study and to create a plan for achieving it.
Be able to communicate well with group members and to pursue the study.
Be able to solve technical challenges in the study by yourself.
Be able to compile results of the study as a final report (i.e., project report).
Be able to make presentations about results of the study effectively.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
